mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or 20-day forward returns in downturn periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three months signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of RSAFS growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a weakening supply side, which leads to reduced corporate output and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or 20-day forward returns in slowdown periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or 5-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 5% each over three months signals a strong demand environment, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS increase > 5% each in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or 20-day forward returns in boom periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in a month signals deflationary pressures, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or 20-day forward returns in deflationary periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% in a quarter signals a strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in periods of GDP growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
